fields.title: 0. Changes since the previous report
fields.md:
This report confirms two things. **The 13F has not yet been posted to the SEC.** And the only new filing since the previous report (FWP, 2026-11-13) is the **final terms of the yen-denominated bonds**, which closes T8. Probabilities and assumed value band do not move — no rule has been satisfied.
